/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd, re
df=pd.read_excel('field_visit_log.xlsx', header=4)
# deduplicate by Visit ID keeping first
df=df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')
# normalize village for completeness
def norm_village(v):
    if pd.isna(v): return ''
    s=str(v).strip()
    s=re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()
df['Village_norm']=df['Village'].apply(norm_village)
# parse travel
def parse_travel(x):
    if pd.isna(x): return 0
    s=str(x).replace('₹','').replace(',','').strip()
    try:
        return float(s)
    except:
        return 0
df['Travel_val']=df['Travel Reimbursement (INR)'].apply(parse_travel)
# filter
mask=(df['State'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()=='maharashtra') & (df['Programme'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()=='water security')
filtered=df[mask]
total=filtered['Travel_val'].sum()
print('Rows:', len(filtered))
print(filtered[['Visit ID','State','Programme','Travel Reimbursement (INR)','Travel_val']])
print('Total:', total)
\"
